description: Use this when the user wants to share a tender or send someone its link. Returns a link anyone can open without signing in: it shows what the public notice says, and chat apps preview it with the tender's name, value and closing date. Give the link as it is. Nothing about the user or their workspace is in the link or on the page.

tender_reference.description: The notice ID, procurement identifier, solicitation number or the buyer's own reference, e.g. "012345-2026" on Find a Tender, "WS4851234567" on CanadaBuys or "140D0427Q0879" on SAM.gov.

name: share_tender

link.description: The share link: give it to the user as it is.

shared.description: False when the tender's source can't be shared yet.

title: Share a tender
